(define (safe-read text)
  (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (if (read-error? e) (list 'bad-syntax (error-object-message e)) (list 'other-failure)))
    (lambda () (read (open-input-string text)))))
(display (list (safe-read "(a b)") (safe-read "(a b")))
(newline)

(define (parse-or-default text fallback)
  (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (if (read-error? e) fallback (raise e))) (lambda () (read (open-input-string text)))))
(display (list (parse-or-default "(1 2 3)" 'default) (parse-or-default "(1 2" 'default)))
(newline)

(define (read-all text)
  (let ((p (open-input-string text)))
    (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (list 'stopped (read-error? e)))
      (lambda () (let loop ((acc '())) (let ((d (read p))) (if (eof-object? d) (reverse acc) (loop (cons d acc)))))))))
(display (list (read-all "1 2 3") (read-all "1 (2")))
(newline)

(define (lint text)
  (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (if (read-error? e) (list 'syntax (error-object-message e)) (list 'runtime))) (lambda () (begin (read (open-input-string text)) (list 'ok)))))
(display (list (lint "(define x 1)") (lint "(define x")))
(newline)
